# Helpers shared by the engine and the GUI (namespace art::utils)

include_directories(${EXTRA_INCDIR}
    ${GLIB2_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${GLIBMM_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${GIOMM_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${GOBJECT_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${GTHREAD_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    )

link_directories(${EXTRA_LIBDIR}
    ${GLIB2_LIBRARY_DIRS}
    ${GLIBMM_LIBRARY_DIRS}
    ${GIOMM_LIBRARY_DIRS}
    ${GOBJECT_LIBRARY_DIRS}
    ${GTHREAD_LIBRARY_DIRS}
    )

set(UTILSSOURCEFILES
    multilangmgr.cc
    pathutils.cc
    threadutils.cc
    )

# version.h (generated by UpdateInfo.cmake) and config.h (below) end up here
include_directories(BEFORE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")

add_library(art_utils ${UTILSSOURCEFILES})
add_dependencies(art_utils UpdateInfo)

if(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    install(TARGETS art_utils DESTINATION ${LIBDIR})
endif()

target_link_libraries(art_utils
    ${EXTRA_LIB}
    ${GLIB2_LIBRARIES}
    ${GLIBMM_LIBRARIES}
    ${GIOMM_LIBRARIES}
    ${GOBJECT_LIBRARIES}
    ${GTHREAD_LIBRARIES}
    )

# Create config.h which defines where data are stored
if(APPLE_NEW_BUNDLE)
    foreach(_v DATADIR DOCDIR CREDITSDIR LICENCEDIR LENSFUNDBDIR)
        if(${_v})
            set(${_v} "../../${${_v}}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config.h.in" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h")
